title: EC2 (Elastic Compute Cloud)
body: An AWS service that provides scalable computing capacity in the cloud. Allows you to launch virtual machines (instances) on demand with configurable CPU, memory, storage, and networking.

title: S3 (Simple Storage Service)
body: An AWS object storage service that offers industry-leading scalability, data availability, security, and performance. Stores data as objects in containers called buckets.

metadata.fair_use_justification: Educational reference guide; glossary format is transformative and non-competitive

title: VPC (Virtual Private Cloud)
body: A logically isolated network environment within AWS where you can launch AWS resources. Provides control over IP address range, subnets, routing tables, and network gateways.

metadata.fair_use_justification: Educational reference guide; glossary format is transformative

title: Lambda
body: An AWS serverless compute service that runs code without provisioning or managing servers. Pay only for the compute time consumed; code runs only when triggered by events.

title: Container
body: A standardized unit of software that packages an application and all its dependencies (code, runtime, system tools, libraries) into a single executable. Enables consistent deployment across environments.

title: Kubernetes
body: An open-source container orchestration platform that automates many of the manual processes involved in deploying, managing, and scaling containerized applications across clusters of machines.
